I: › [ I ] to stand, especially after sitting
› [ I ] formal to get out of bed
› [ I ] specialized geography If a river rises somewhere, it first comes out of the ground there.
› [ I ] When emotions, etc. rise, they start to increase.
C2 [ I ] to become important, successful, or powerful
變得重要（成功或有權力）

I, I: › [ I,  I ] If bread or dough (= a soft uncooked mixture used for making bread) rises, it becomes bigger because of the action of yeast (= a fungus used in beer and bread making).

I usually + adv/prep: › [ I usually + adv/prep ] (of a group of people) to begin to oppose or fight a bad government or ruler

I: › [ I ] formal If parliament or a court rises, it stops work.

S: C2 [ S ] the process of becoming very famous, powerful, or popular

C: › [ C ] a small hill or slope

example: The balloon rose gently (up) into the air.

我們在早晨六點鐘觀看了日出。
